output.summary: Creeping flowering herb native from western Asia through India to East and Southeast Asia. It resembles a true strawberry but has yellow flowers, while the common variety bears glossy red fruit. Its fresh berries are edible but less palatable than true strawberries.
output.edibilityNote: Fresh berries are edible but less palatable than true strawberries; Khasi people also chew the roots with betel nuts.
